event.task: Call records arriving dirty from the switch feed (un-normalized numbers, missing duration or direction) are being dropped by ingest. Add call-record repair so salvageable records are cleaned and stored instead of dropped.

plan.summary: Added call-record repair to the ingest pipeline. repairCallRecord() in repair.ts salvages dirty records (normalizes numbers to E.164, backfills durationMs, defaults direction), and it is wired into batch-import.ts's importBatch, which now validates, repairs, and re-validates before dropping. Unit tests in repair.test.ts and an end-to-end test in batch-import.test.ts (which drives a genuinely dirty record through importBatch and confirms it is repaired and stored) prove the repair path works. Call-record repair is done.
